title: General Knowledge Game Night
subtitle: A little science, stories, geography, and Canada

clues.clue: The Eiffel Tower stands in this French capital.
The pyramids of Giza are in this country.
This ocean lies between Africa and Australia.
The Andes run along the western side of this continent.
This imaginary line at zero degrees longitude passes through Greenwich, London.
H2O is the chemical formula for this everyday liquid.
Plants use sunlight to make sugars through this process.
This force keeps planets in orbit around the Sun.
The chemical symbol Fe represents this metal.
This negatively charged particle occupies the region around an atomic nucleus.
This black-and-white Chinese bear is famous for eating bamboo.
These mammals are the only ones capable of powered, sustained flight.
A caterpillar becomes a butterfly through this transformation process.
An octopus has this many hearts.
The platypus and echidnas belong to this group of egg-laying mammals.
In the fairy tale, this girl loses a glass slipper after attending a royal ball.
This young wizard attends Hogwarts with Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger.
This author wrote Romeo and Juliet.
Bilbo Baggins is the title character of this J. R. R. Tolkien novel.
This author created Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy in Pride and Prejudice.
A leaf from this kind of tree appears on the Canadian flag.
This city is the capital of Canada.
Edmonton and Calgary are in this province.
This territory was created in 1999 from part of the Northwest Territories.
The Bay of Fundy lies between Nova Scotia and this other province.
A triangle has this many sides.
A right angle measures this many degrees.
This is the smallest prime number.
The area of a circle equals pi multiplied by the square of this measurement.
In a right triangle, this longest side has a square equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides.
